ns2:course.label: Introduction to Coding and Precision Management
ns2:course.description: Overview of agricultural systems’ problems and application of different tools and sensors on problem-solving and efficient systems’ design. The course will introduce coding and precision technologies through a hands-on approach. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Credit is not given toward graduation for ANSC 360 and ANSC 480. Prerequisite: Three years of high school mathematics, or MATH 112, or consent of instructor.
